Definition: The numer of days after calving when estrus detection (ED and ED-TAI protocols) begin . When TAI protocol is used, this value will be ignored, and it is recommended to set it to 0.

The fraction of estrous cows that would be detected in the ED (estrus detection) and ED-TAI protocols. When TAI protocol is used, this value will be ignored, and it is recommended to set it to 0. (e.g. `Double OvSynch`, `PreSynch`, `G6G`, `None`)
The proportion of cows conceiving after estrus is detected in the ED and ED-TAI protocols. When TAI protocol is used, this value will be ignored, and it is recommended to set it to 0 (%).

Presynchronization program used before first breeding (1st breeding) for cows (TAI protocol only). For ED or ED-TAI, this value will be ignored and should be set to `None`. (OvSynch 48, OvSynch 56, CoSynch 72, 5d CoSynch, or None)

Day after calving when the first hormone treatment of the Presynch program occurs (TAI protocol only). Durations vary by program selected: PreSynch = 25, Double OvSynch = 16, and G6G = 8 days. This will be ignored when other protocols such as ED or ED-TAI are used, and should be set to 0 (days).
The OvSynch program to be used for cows in the TAI and the ED-TAI protocols. When the ED protocol is used, this value will be ignored, and it is recommended to set it to `None`

When set properly in the TAI protocol, OvSynch program start day is the day of the first GnRH injection in an OvSynch program. When the OvSynch program follows a presynch program, the start day of the OvSynch program should be on or after the last day of the presynch program. Otherwise, the OvSynch program will be shifted to start on the last day of the presynch program. When ED-TAI protocol is used and no estrus detected between the end of the voluntary waiting period and this OvSynch program start day, then the OvSynch program will start on this day. When the ED protocol is used, this value will be ignored, and it is recommended to set it to 0.
The conception rate for the OvSynch program used in the TAI and ED-TAI protocols. When the ED protocol is used, this value will be ignored, and it is recommended to set it to 0.

Resynchronization program used relative to the first pregnancy check in the TAI and ED-TAI repro protocols. When the ED protocol is used, this should be `None`. *Note: If `PGFatPD` is chosen, the values for estrus detection rate and conception rate tare determined by `estrus_detection_rate` and `ED_conception_rate`. Anytime an insemination is performed after an ovsynch program, the conception rate will be changed to the `ovsynch_program_conception_rate`.
